name: dataset_read
description: Read shared datasets: list them, or read one's value, hash, status (ok/stale/empty), editable, warnings and the pages using it; path (e.g. a[id=o1].b) narrows the value. refresh:true fetches online data now. sinceHash (e.g. from page_read datasetBases) returns record-level changes since then, paged with offset/limit. query {filter, sorts, search} reads a {columns, rows} value as records with derived values, filtered like a database view. Actions: list{}; read{datasetId,path?,sinceHash?,offset?,limit?,refresh?,query?}.

projectId.description: Authorized shared project ID returned by projects_list.

name: dataset_write
description: Change shared datasets; see use-showai. create: value, or fromBlock {pageId,blockId,baseHash} to share and bind a block's props. apply: read baseHash + operations {op:"set",path,value}, {op:"remove",path}, {op:"insert",path:list,value,after?}, {op:"move",path:item,after}; path selects records by id ([id=t1]). link url: online json/csv/tsv/xlsx, read-only. transform: read-only data from script "function transform(inputs, helpers)", inputs {name:datasetId}; dryRun:true runs it unsaved. Actions: create{name,datasetId?,description?,value?,schema?,fromBlock?}; apply{datasetId,baseHash,operations,name?,description?,schema?}; link{datasetId?,url?,format?,refreshSeconds?,use?,name?,description?,value?,schema?,baseHash?}; transform{datasetId?,baseHash?,name?,description?,schema?,inputs?,script?,dryRun?}.
